scientific_integrity: New contribution is the sharp fixed-frame nonuniform-weight stability and full absolute-Gram spectrum, not the previously published uniform-weight projection constant. All general-dimensional steps are analytic; finite computation is only corroborating.
scientific_limitations: For the fixed regular-simplex midpoint Parseval frame in real integer dimensions m>=4; not a classification of frames or a proof of global maximality. The m=3 frame has no positive spectral gap. Independent mathematical and publication-priority review are not performed.
title: Sharp weight rigidity and a spectral crossover for regular-simplex midpoint frames
